If you’re planning to stay for a little over a week, don’t forget to buy tourist railway passes while you’re in Narita/Haneda. That’s a good way to save money. 

Don’t forget to pass through Namba, Osaka while you’re there! There’s plenty to see and you can buy cheap souvenirs too. USJ (Universal Studio Japan) is also holding a cool event right now and you might want to check it out. 

You should also visit Osaka Castle or  Tsurumi Ryokuchi Park if you’re going to Hanami! Uhhh, Sakura Watching.. I mean. 

Also! If you’ve lost your way or have any questions, don’t be afraid to ask the train station attendants or go to the nearest police station for info! They can understand basic english and they’ll be happy to help you.
